from.place: proof, part (<=): the assertion that the global-sections field k' is separable over k

title: Separability of global sections
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X$ be a smooth projective curve over $k$ [def-pc-smooth-projective-curve], and put $k'=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$. Assume that the structure map makes $k'/k$ a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. Then $k'/k$ is separable [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension].

source.place: Lemma 0BUG (lemma-proper-geometrically-reduced-global-sections), clause (4): separability of H^0(X,O_X) over k for proper geometrically reduced X

proof.text: Because $X\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ is projective by [def-pc-smooth-projective-curve], it is proper by [lem-pc-projective-proper]. Because the same morphism is smooth, [sbc-lem-smooth-geometrically-reduced] gives geometrically reduced fibres; since the base is $\operatorname{Spec}(k)$, this says that $X$ is geometrically reduced over $k$.

source.place: Lemma 0BUG, hypotheses and clause (4); smoothness gives geometrically reduced fibres and projectivity gives properness

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-proper-geometrically-reduced-global-sections-separable] to this proper geometrically reduced $X$ and to the assumed field extension $k'=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ over $k$. Its conclusion is exactly that $k'/k$ is separable.
